product.title: Columbus World’s Fair Cast Iron Mechanical Bank Book of Knowledge Reproduction
product.description:
Columbus World’s Fair Cast Iron Mechanical Bank

A raised sailing ship and a hinged log that reveals a second painted figure make this cast-iron bank a distinctive piece for a mechanical bank collection.

This vintage American-made Book of Knowledge reproduction depicts the Columbus World’s Fair Bank design associated with the 1893 World’s Columbian Exposition in Chicago. The underside is marked Columbus, Reproduced from Original in Collection of The Book of Knowledge, and Made in U.S.A.

Condition

Scattered paint chips and paint loss, surface rubbing and accumulated dust. Both figures and the coin access cover are present. The mechanism cycles. Coin deposition has not been tested. Please review all photographs. This is a vintage reproduction of the 1893 design.

Details

Painted cast iron. Measures 8 × 2¼ × 4¼ inches and weighs 2 lb 9.6 oz unpacked.

Included

One Columbus mechanical bank as pictured.

Packing & Shipping

The cast-iron base will be secured in a sturdy corrugated box with clearance around the moving figures. Buyer-paid calculated ground shipping and 30-day buyer-paid returns.
